_about: Shared cases for the pre-registered checkpoint evaluators: scripts/decision_pack.py evaluate() / evaluate_shadow() and their JS mirror in public/js/journal.js (prEvaluate / prEvaluateShadow). Expected verdicts were produced by decision_pack; tests/test_checkpoint_mirror.py re-derives them and test/journal_checkpoints.test.js runs the JS against them. A case may carry `open` rows: hc4-2's entry-cohort lines (set 3 Nov 2026) read them too. Since 3 Nov PR-1 carries its replay-veto read, so a first-read trip of PR-1 now HOLDs for the final 40-close re-read.
